shared_elements: head or face above a torso
central circular or oval torso ornament
horizontal bands or linear geometric decoration
bilateral symmetry around a vertical axis
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both present a frontal, vertically oriented anthropomorphic figure with a head/face over a torso, paired circular chest marks, and central torso ornamentation arranged symmetrically. The biggest difference is that B is a detailed standing figure with legs, arms, elaborate headdress, flanking/attached complex motifs, and dense figural ornament, whereas A is a much more abstract block-like body with only sparse incised signs and bands.
